name: moonbit_sudoku_solver
description: MoonBit Sudoku Solver fixture exercising coordinate lookup, peer/unit table construction, constraint propagation, contradiction handling, and DFS search.

exports.name: contradiction_traps
exports.description: Harness export that builds an impossible grid with duplicate row givens and expects the real parser/constraint propagation code to trap.

exports.name: hard_grid_matches
exports.description: Harness export that calls solve(grid1) for the documented harder Norvig-style puzzle and compares the formatted solved grid with the documented expected solution.

exports.name: propagation_grid_matches
exports.description: Harness export that parses grid2 and verifies the puzzle is solved by assignment/elimination propagation against the documented expected solution.

exports.name: helper_tables_match
exports.description: Harness export that validates coordinate lookup plus generated unit and peer tables before the solver tests run.

tests.description: exercise Sudoku helper tables, propagation, full search, and contradiction paths
tests.notes: The MoonBit solver works with GC-managed strings, sorted sets, and Grid values, so the JSON runner cannot directly inspect those internals. Each i32 result is produced by a small harness function that constructs a real puzzle, calls the documented solver implementation, compares against a known solved grid, and returns 1 only when that internal check passes.

steps.description: build and validate square indices plus unit and peer tables
steps.notes: Checks square_to_int("C3") == 20, units["A1"] == A2,A3,B1,B2,B3,C1,C2,C3, and peers["A1"].length() == 20.

steps.description: solve a puzzle through constraint propagation alone
steps.notes: Uses the docs grid2 puzzle beginning '003020600 / 900305001 / 001806400 ...' and verifies the full formatted solution beginning '4 8 3 | 9 2 1 | 6 5 7'. This primarily exercises Grid::parse, assign, eliminate, peer propagation, and Grid::format.

steps.description: solve a harder Norvig-style puzzle through recursive search
steps.notes: Uses the documented magictour/top95-style grid1 puzzle beginning '4 . . | . . . | 8 . 5' and verifies the full solution beginning '4 1 7 | 3 6 9 | 8 2 5'. This reaches search() in addition to the propagation code.

steps.description: reject a contradictory row with duplicate givens
steps.notes: Builds an impossible puzzle with two '1' givens in the first row, then calls Grid::parse. The expected trap proves the contradiction path is exercised rather than silently accepting invalid input.

source.description: Apache-2.0 MoonBit documentation Sudoku solver compiled with a local export harness for corpus smoke tests.

notes: The committed Wasm was built from the official MoonBit docs Sudoku solver plus a local export harness. The harness does not replace the algorithm: it calls the real square_to_int, unit/peer construction, Grid::parse, assign, eliminate, search, solve, and Grid::format functions, then reduces the internal MoonBit GC/string results to simple i32 pass/fail exports that this corpus runner can assert. The two positive tests compare complete formatted solved grids, not just spot checks.
